text:
michael: Quick interlock — runtime perf sprint checkpoint. 3 asks: who owns the remaining work, any blocking infra deps, and are there regressions on master? Short summary: kernel preempt PR, batching config change rolled, KV eviction experiment flaky. Ping owners for status.

tara: I own the batching change. Canary started ~2h ago; noticing ~8% increase in 99p latency for long-context (>2k) requests. Gathering traces now, will post dashboards in 30m. cc @cheng for kernel coupling.

cheng: Kernel preempt PR #431 is awaiting review. I can merge after jess approves the ctx cancel fix she flagged. Repro for the integration failure: `make run-integration TEST=kernel_preempt`. Also seeing KV hit-rate dip correlated with the candidate build.

jess: Left an inline on #431 about a missing ctx cancel and a potential goroutine leak. I'll run the eviction test locally and push a small patch. KV hit-rate drop looks like prefix cache TTL wasn't applied after certain invalidation paths — digging in.

devon: Eng-infra is currently blocking the canary due to a PSP/SA mismatch in the dedicated-stage cluster; ticket INF-289 filed with priority-high. ETA currently tomorrow morning unless they can reassign.

ci-bot: CI on PR-431 failed: `runtime/kv_cache_test.go: TestEvictionPolicy` timed out. Excerpt: ```--- FAIL: TestEvictionPolicy (30.12s)
    cache_test.go:142: expected eviction sequence but got none
    --- FAIL: TestEvictionPolicy (30.12s)```

michael: Options: 1) split merge (kernel preempt behind a flag), 2) pause canary, or 3) limited rollout to dedicated-only. Need decision by EOD.

tara: I prefer staged: dedicated-only canary, gather 24h of metrics. @devon can infra prioritize INF-289 so we can use non-dedicated path?

devon: Added urgency label and pinged infra lead. If they can't unblock today, plan B is to lower canary weight to 5% and hold.

cheng: I'll add a feature flag `kernel.preempt_enabled` (default=false) and document the rollout steps in the PR. Example toggle command: `redwoodctl feature set kernel.preempt_enabled=true --env=dedicated-stage`. Will also add test skip flag to make CI greener for quick validation.

jess: I'll open a hotfix branch for the KV TTL fix: `hotfix/kv-ttl-2026-03-17` and link PR here. Will request review from @michael once ready.

michael: Action items recap: cheng — add feature flag + update PR description with rollback steps; jess — hotfix PR for kv TTL; devon — push infra priority on INF-289; tara — limit canary to dedicated-only for 24h and monitor 99p; if anything regresses, pause and rollback. I'll follow up in the morning. :thumbsup:
